purpose: Explore matched action effects and qualify new instrumentation before independent confirmation

scientific_contract.dataset: Pinned first 5000 CIFAR-10 images, existing prepared normalization
scientific_contract.objective: Half squared error summed across ten outputs and averaged over all 5000 images
scientific_contract.initialization: Exact frozen Run215/Analysis024 seed0 tensors; verify hashes before execution

fork.immutable_snapshot: Before consuming the fork gradient, including prior gradient and actual step
fork.reselection_rule: If historical replay fails, record and amend design before treatment inspection

arms.placement: after full accumulation and before both moment updates

arms.moments: continue both ordinary moments; bypass m_hat only in applied numerator

arms.fallback: preconditioned raw-gradient descent if ordinary direction is not descending
arms.on_exhaustion: restore complete state, mark stalled, stop

arms.formula: alpha_hat=(g_current dot d_current)/((s_previous dot y)/(s_previous dot s_previous) * (d_current dot d_current))
arms.eligibility: finite inputs, reductions and alpha_hat; nonzero s_previous and d_current; g_current dot d_current > 0; secant_alignment_condition
arms.tolerance_interpretation: development tolerance on secant alignment; not proof of numerical curvature resolution
arms.invalid_case: base learning rate with reason logged

capture.selected_dense_history: Declared short windows only; no unrestricted full-history dumping

evaluation.heldout_test_use: descriptive only; never method or threshold selection

execution_envelope.device: owned local GPU, production-shaped memory check required
execution_envelope.source_of_expectation: Historical MLP median0.01168seconds/update and complete1024-update arm14.90seconds; allowance adds unmeasured qualification, state and trial costs
